title: Unpackables
description: Lets you craft blocks like Wool back into String.
body:
Lets you unpack certain blocks like:

- Wool(Regardless Of Color) Craftable Into 4 String

- Blue Ice Craftable Into 9 Packed Ice

- Packed Ice Craftable Into 9 Ice

- 4 flint Craftable Into 1 Gravel

- HoneyComb Blocks Craftable Into 9 HoneyComb

More May Be Added Later
